newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling maintains gains on dollar.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling maintains gains on dollar.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling maintained steady gains against the dollar on Thursday in an unmatched market, commercial bank dealers said.

The Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate of 54.55 against the dollar compared to 54.57 on Wednesday. Against the pound, the shilling was posted at a mean rate of 88.58 from 88.82 on Wednesday.
Dealers said there were a lot of inflows coming in from coffee export sales and foreign investors looking to buy treasury bills.
Some dealers said despite some modest demand from a few corporate buyers, it was not enough to stem the shilling's appreciation against the dollar.
"With such little buying interest, the shilling will remain bullish," one dealer said.
The money market was liquid with overnight rates quoted between 6-12 percent compared to 5-10 percent on Wednesday.
